## Order on the form of the expenses account

The account must be revised to distinguish preparation, attendance and copying charges. The present order concerns presentation of the account only. It does not identify the parties or determine the final sum recoverable between them.

The terms pursuer and defender indicate procedural capacities. The terms plaintiff and defendant appear in a comparative note supplied with the specimen and likewise identify no individual. A solicitor-advocate is an occupation, and the specimen must not contain a fictional name merely to illustrate that field.

Preparation time must be recorded against the relevant task. A single undifferentiated entry for “case work” is insufficient where part of the recorded time concerns another matter. Copying charges must state the number of pages and the rate used.

The provisional total of GBP 420 is an amount under review. The proposed attendance date is 14 January 2027. Neither the amount nor the date is a personal identifier. Section 5.1, article 18 and schedule 4 are references within the account procedure, not docket or claim numbers.

The revised account is to be supplied within seven days. Objections must identify the item disputed and the correction sought. Empty fields for a signature, contact address or personal document number must remain empty in this circulation copy.

All questions concerning entitlement to the disputed expenses are reserved.
